purpose: Define the minimum candidate-row export needed to bridge any separately frozen research model into the prospective shadow recorder without changing that model's selection logic.

freeze_identity.experiment_id: must come from the immutable freeze manifest
freeze_identity.model_freeze_id: must come from the immutable freeze manifest

timing_rule: feature_cutoff must be the actual causal cutoff used for the candidate row; do not replace it with report-generation time or post-close reconstruction time.
selection_rule: export rows only after the frozen model's own eligibility/ranking/cooldown policy has completed; this contract must not re-rank, threshold, filter, or create additional candidates.

current_compatibility_finding.v14_fast_replay: aggregate JSON only; selected candidate rows are constructed internally but not exported, so it is not directly shadow-recordable without a separate row-export surface after model freeze
current_compatibility_finding.action: do not modify V14/V15/V16 selection logic in this lane; add row export only when a model is explicitly designated for prospective shadow

endpoint_target: next official XTKS session open to fifth official XTKS session close
